extraction_notes: The supplied MPN IRLML2030TRPBF corresponds to the datasheet spelling IRLML2030TRPbF; p. 10 lists IRLML2030TRPbF as the orderable part number. The datasheet is branded International Rectifier and the job metadata identifies the manufacturer as Infineon Technologies.
The IRLML2030TRPbF is an N-channel device. Electrical characteristics are specified at TJ = 25 degC unless otherwise stated.

The output, transfer, capacitance, and source-drain diode points are manual digitizations of real curves in p. 3 and p. 4; no fitted or interpolated vendor SPICE data was used. Output and transfer plots specify pulse width <= 60 us where shown.

The two published RDS(on) rows each have typical and maximum values: 123 mOhm typical and 154 mOhm maximum at VGS = 4.5 V, ID = 2.2 A; and 80 mOhm typical and 100 mOhm maximum at VGS = 10 V, ID = 2.7 A. All four values are preserved as separate schema entries.

Additional published values not represented by dedicated schema fields include breakdown-voltage temperature coefficient 0.03 V per degC, IDSS maximum 1 uA at VDS = 24 V and VGS = 0 V, gate resistance 7.6 ohm typical, gfs minimum 2.6 S, Qg 1.0 nC typical, Qgs 0.34 nC typical, Qgd 0.34 nC typical, and switching times at their stated conditions.

Source-drain data include IS maximum 1.6 A, ISM maximum 11 A, VSD maximum 1.0 V at IS = 2.7 A, trr 9.0 ns typical and 14 ns maximum, and Qrr 0.3 nC typical and 0.4 nC maximum. The structured body_diode value is the published VSD maximum.
Thermal data provide RthetaJA maximum 100 K/W and a maximum 99 K/W condition for t < 10 s; no RthetaJC value is published.
